fuente.titulo: Pope Leo departs for Apostolic Journey to Latin America

titular: Pope Leo XIV departs for Latin America trip
bajada: 12-day journey will take him to Uruguay, Argentina and Peru
caption: Pope Leo XIV has departed on his 12-day Apostolic Journey to Latin America, his sixth international trip since becoming pope. The visit will include stops in Uruguay, Argentina and Peru. Source: Vatican News, Nov 6, 2026.

ilustracion.descripcion: An airport tarmac at dawn with a plane ready for departure; a figure in white papal attire boards the stairs in the upper right third, left and center clear.
